WITH employee_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    ReportsTo,
    COUNT(*) AS group_count
  FROM Employee
  GROUP BY ReportsTo
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    SUM(group_count) AS total_employees,
    COUNT(*) AS num_groups
  FROM employee_groups
)
SELECT 
  eg.ReportsTo,
  eg.group_count AS employee_count,
  eg.group_count * 1.0 / t.total_employees AS share,
  eg.group_count * 1.0 / t.total_employees - 1.0 / t.num_groups AS difference_from_avg
FROM employee_groups eg
CROSS JOIN totals t
ORDER BY difference_from_avg DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The average share across groups is 1 / (number of groups), representing what each group's share would be under uniform distribution.
